name: queueless
description: QR-based digital ordering and billing system for food shops

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n "api,customer,admin" -c "blue,green,magenta" "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace=packages/types && npm run build --workspace=packages/validation && npm run build --workspace=packages/database
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.db:setup: npm run db:generate && npm run db:push && npm run db:seed
